body.input: Which medical device companies opened an office in Sweden in 2026?

response.content:
I was unable to find specific reports of medical device companies that opened a new office in Sweden during 2026. The searches returned lists of existing medtech companies already based in Sweden (over 250 are tracked) and general industry news, but no announcements specifically about a medical device company establishing a new office in Sweden this year.

If you are tracking a particular company or segment, I'd be happy to look into that more specifically.
